tm.「そっちに行くと 追っ手に見つかるわ。\n ヤツらが 来る前に\n 祭壇のほうに: "If we go that way, our pursuers will find us. Let's go back to the altar before they come.
tm.「そっちは ダメよ！\n 早く 山を下りて みんなと合流しましょう！: "Not that way! Hurry down the mountain and meet up with everyone!
tm.「待って {var:1}！\n みんなが 戻っているかもしれないわ。\n 城のほ: "Wait, {var:1}! The others may have come back. Let's search toward the castle too.
tm.「ここは どんな場所なのか……探索すれば\n 何か 新しい発見が あるかもしれな: "If we explore what kind of place this is, we may find something new. Let's look around inside a bit.
tm.「さあ 来た道を戻って ユグノア城跡に\n 様子を見にいってみるぞい。: "Now, let's go back the way we came and check on the Dundrasil Castle ruins.
tm.「さあ 来た道を戻って\n ユグノア城跡に 行くぞい。: "Now, let's go back the way we came to the Dundrasil Castle ruins.
tm.ボロボロに 壊れている壁画だ。\n失われた時の化身と呼ばれる 精霊が\n光の玉の: A badly broken mural. A spirit called the Embodiment of Lost Time holds up something like a ball of light.
tm.壁画には 何やら\n不思議な形をした 穴があいている……。: The mural has an oddly shaped hole in it...
tm.今は ロウの後を追ったほうが よさそうだ。: It seems best to follow Rab for now.
tm.「おい {var:1}。あの じいさん\n なにか 見せたいものが あるみたいだ: "Hey, {var:1}. That old man seems to want to show us something. Shouldn't we follow him?
tm.「じいさんと一緒にいる あの女の正体……。\n さっきの話で ようやく 確信が持: "The woman with the old man... What we just heard finally convinced me. She's... you know, right?
tm.「あたしたちも あの 蝶みたいに\n 命の大樹まで 飛んでいけたら\n 苦労しな: "If only we could fly to Yggdrasil like that butterfly, it'd be so much easier...
tm.「って こんなときに 不謹慎だったわね……。\n ごめんなさい {var:1}。: "Oh, that was insensitive of me at a time like this... Sorry, {var:1}.
tm.「王妃さまの 勇気ある行動に\n {var:1}さまは 救われていたのですね。: "So {var:1} was saved by the Queen's brave act.
tm.「その 大切な お命……。これからも\n お姉さまと共に お守りいたしますわ。: "That precious life... Together with my sister, I will keep protecting it.
tm.「とっても 美しい儀式だったわね……。\n 国王夫妻の魂も きっと\n なぐさめ: "That was such a beautiful ceremony... The souls of the King and Queen must surely be comforted.
tm.ユグノア王 アーウィンと\n王妃 エレノア ここに眠る: Here lie Irwin, King of Dundrasil, and Queen Eleonor
tm.「ふうふう……。さすがに 老体に\n この坂道は こたえるわい。\n すまんが: "Huff, puff... This slope is hard on an old body. Sorry to make you come along.
tm.「{var:1}に どうしても\n 見せておきたいものが あってな……。\n さ: "There is something I simply must show {var:1}... Come, follow me.
tm.「あのアーウィンが まさか こんな姿に\n なってしまっていたとはな……。\n: "To think Irwin has ended up like this... I must save him no matter what.
tm.「のう {var:1}よ。息子の お前ならば\n アーウィンを助けてやれるかもし: "Say, {var:1}. As his son, you may be able to help Irwin. Won't you listen to his voice?
tm.「俺は １６年前 デルカダール王を救出するため\n 部隊を率いて この地を訪れた: "Sixteen years ago, I led a squad here to rescue the King of Heliodor. I was one of those present at that tragedy.
tm.「……{var:1}よ。\n アーウィンさまは とても立派な戦士だった。\n 何: "...{var:1}, Lord Irwin was a truly fine warrior. Never forget that, whatever happens.
tm.「暗く悲しい悪夢から 彼を解放してあげて……\n さっきの声の主は そう言ってた: "Free him from the dark, sad nightmare... that's what the owner of that voice said.
tm.「早く {var:1}ちゃんのパパを\n ゆっくり休ませてあげる方法を探さなきゃ: "We have to find a way to let {var:1}'s dad rest in peace, quickly! Right, {var:1}?
tm.「家族のことも覚えてない オレから見れば\n なんだか うらやましいです……。\: "To me, who can't even remember my family, that seems enviable... Did I have a family too...?
tm.どうやら ロウの日記のようだ。: It seems to be Rab's diary.
tm.アーウィンに 王位をゆずって以来\nあやつは ユグノア王国を発展させるべく\n精: Ever since I passed the throne to Irwin, he has done his utmost to develop the Kingdom of Dundrasil.
tm.はじめこそ 王族でなかった アーウィンに\n王位を継がせることを よく思わない\: At first, some of the people disliked a non-royal like Irwin inheriting the throne...
tm.今では皆 新たな若き王を信じ したがっている。\nアーウィンの 国を思う ひたむ: Now everyone believes in and follows the new young king. Irwin's earnest devotion to his country must have united their hearts.
tm.エレノアが アーウィンを選んだのは\n正しい判断だった……これで わしも\n安心: Eleonor was right to choose Irwin... Now I can enjoy my retirement in peace.
tm.「さあ いつまでも なげいていてはいかんな。\n 気を引きしめて 次の目的地へ向: "Now, we mustn't keep mourning. Steel yourselves and head for our next destination.
tm.「ここより北にある グロッタの町ならば\n 人も多いし 新たな情報が得られるかも: "Octagonia, to the north, has many people and may give us new information. Let's go at once.
tm.「見ろよ。そこら中 ガレキの山だぜ。\n たしか ここは ただの湖だったはずなの: "Look, rubble everywhere. This was supposed to be just a lake. What on earth happened...
tm.「なんて 常識に とらわれない\n 個性的で エキセントリックな装飾なの……。\: "What unconventional, individualistic, eccentric decorations... This is a wonderful work of art!
tm.「きっと ここに 住んでいた人たちは\n ステキな感性の持ち主だったのね！: "The people who lived here must have had wonderful sensibilities!
tm.「さっき 遺跡を調べていたら\n 古い時代の 書物を見つけてのう。\n 興味深い: "While investigating the ruins earlier, I found an old book. It has interesting things written in it.
tm.「……覚えておるか {var:1}よ。\n かつて 太陽の神殿の苗木を通して見た: "...Remember, {var:1}? The recollection of Erdwin's life we saw through the sapling at the Temple of the Sun...
tm.「この書物には その回想が\n 詳細に 記されておるんじゃよ。\n そんな書物が: "This book records that recollection in detail. Why would such a book be in these ruins...
tm.「姫さまの おっしゃっていた通り\n この辺りに落ちている ガレキの装飾は\n: "Just as the Princess said, the rubble decorations here match those we saw in Havens Above.
tm.「しかし……グロッタの南に\n 神の民の里に ゆかりのある遺跡があるなんて\n: "But a ruin tied to Havens Above, south of Octagonia? I've never heard of it...
tm.『ローシュ戦記』という本だ。: It's a book called "The Chronicles of Erdwin."
tm.～第一章 はじまりの詩～\n生命を紡ぐ 命の大樹\nその息吹より生まれし 光の勇: ~Chapter One: Song of the Beginning~ Yggdrasil, weaver of life. From its breath was born the Luminary of light.
tm.勇者の光 尽きることなき まばゆさで\n果ては 漆黒の影を生みださん。\n影の名: The Luminary's endless light shall give rise to a pitch-black shadow: the evil god who rules chaos.
tm.～第二章 祈りの詩～\n命の大樹の息吹 聖なる山の頂に\n愛の祈りを ひびかせん: ~Chapter Two: Song of Prayer~ Yggdrasil's breath, on the holy mountain's peak, shall echo a prayer of love.
tm.祈りを受けて生まれし 赤子。\nその者の名は セニカ。\n勇者を守る 聖賢の乙女: A child born of the prayer. Her name is Senya, the sage maiden who protects the Luminary.
tm.……この本は 長くなりそうだ。\n{var:1}は そっと 本を閉じた。: ...This book looks like a long one. {var:1} quietly closed it.
tm.『ロトゼタシアの歴史・時空の章』という本だ。: It's a book called "History of Erdrea: The Chapter of Time."
tm.我ら 神の民の一族に伝わりし伝承……。\nかの時代より この地に在りつづける\n: A tradition handed down by our people of Havens Above... I record here the law of time, kept in this land since that era.
tm.ロトゼタシアの大地より 生まれし\n悠久の時間を紡ぐ 精霊。\nその名は 失われ: A spirit born of the land of Erdrea, weaving eternal time. Its name: the Embodiment of Lost Time.
tm.失われた時の化身が 守りしは\n刻限を司る 神聖なる光。: What the Embodiment of Lost Time guards is a sacred light that governs the hour.
tm.その光 かがやき燃ゆる時\n悠久の彼方に 失われしものが\n大いなる 復活を果た: When that light shines and burns, what was lost in the far reaches of eternity shall be reborn.
